goal: Prepare bounded tasks, inspect sourced readiness, preserve work admission and observe engineering outcomes.
invariants: Gardener distinguishes supported parser-associated comments/directives from detector literals, reports malformed/unsupported coverage, and retains bounded redacted sourced identities.

Gardener proposals revalidate current source/configuration, preserve existing bytes, use the local provider only, and remain needs-triage without execution authorization, passing proof or implementation acceptance.
Recurrence counts distinct task/event identities within comparable workflow/risk contexts and reports missing control provenance rather than inferring a common root cause.
Sensitive paths impose a risk floor.

Explicit independently selected pre-change policy context preserves maximum scope floors, required checks and command bindings, stronger autonomy/review/human gates and immutable proof/work bindings; missing or drifting context rejects before admission effects, while candidate-only evaluation is labeled informational for control transitions.
Reviewable work requires passing proof.
Unsupported work providers cannot imply readiness or transition support.
Work readiness references the explicit selected proof attempt; failed or interrupted attempts cannot establish review readiness.
Completed work shares the accepted proof validator with audit; legacy plan notes cannot replace review of actual implementation.
Unsupported CLI action flags fail before repository mutation or execution; only init accepts dry-run.

The ARRS checkout policy imposes justified R3 floors on configuration, every shipped schema and control implementations; proof/work cannot declare lower risk, while consumer policy locations and unrelated documentation remain unchanged.
Verification targets must be explicitly owned configuration entries; absent inherited names cannot satisfy maps, readiness or command execution, while valid own names retain literal argv.
Work review readiness and completion reject proof with safely normalized root/output scope aliases through the shared technical and accepted validators.
Filesystem-identical case aliases of reserved root proof scope cannot establish capture, validation, work or audit acceptance; distinct case-sensitive source entries retain freshness coverage.

Filesystem-identical source aliases and ancestor scopes retain the maximum sensitive-path and Feature Map implementation/entry-point risk floor; distinct entries and exact missing suffixes preserve source semantics.

Automatic lifecycle facts and append-only windowed observations preserve unknown metric denominators and never change proof/work risk, readiness, approval or autonomy; immutable duplicate source identities cannot inflate task/attempt counts.

Task preparation is deterministic and read-only by default; selected maps, scoped instructions, decisions, source hashes and exact command bindings retain provenance, unresolved inputs and policy gates without granting execution readiness or acceptance.
Optional preparation output preserves earlier packets in safe ignored storage and rejects unsafe paths or trust drift before effects.

Scoped readiness composes shared work admission and canonical selected evidence; feature-only suitability remains unknown, task/proof association and protected scope/risk gates stay explicit, and read-only inspection performs no execution or transition.

Optional local MCP pins one launch-selected repository, reuses shared inspection semantics, exposes no writes or configured execution, omits source/log contents by default and rejects expired, mismatched or stale bounded continuation handles.
acceptance: Preparation produces deterministic scoped context and technically validated draft contracts, retaining exact commands, provenance and unresolved inputs without execution or readiness claims.
Risk classification and work admission retain sensitive-path and selected-feature floors, reject unsafe context/unsupported providers and preserve original work bytes on rejection.
Work moves to review-ready only with the selected current passing proof and completes only with acceptance bound to that attempt; previous failures and pending review remain visible.
Explicit local metrics produce outcome denominators without claiming missing observations as success; repeated recorded failures support bounded Gardener findings.

The opt-in pilot ledger command preserves unknown review/defect values, excludes category/risk/window-mismatched pairs, links canonical proof attempts and separate acceptance, and rejects malformed/unsafe input without modifying observations.
Readiness retains sourced prerequisites, task-matched current evidence, exact shared state advice and explicit Git/CI/architecture limits without granting acceptance or executing commands.
A real named stdio SDK client discovers strict typed read-only tools, preserves CLI semantic validation and proves no configured execution or repository mutation.
